Upwork surfaced fresh Worldwide WordPress/WooCommerce work, but current candidates were expert/development-heavy, strong-English, low-budget or highly competitive. Reddit results were freelancer supply-side rather than hiring demand. Facebook yielded 0 concrete publicly verifiable hiring posts.
